title: Snes' PvP
description: A very simple PvP textures that i had one image to work off of ill send it in the gallery
body: This mod is a basic PvP texture pack that make the game easier for PvP combat. With shorter swords it now doesnt take up half of your screen and the basic wool well that just is decoration just like the following blocks. Grass block, Stone, Tuff, Deepslate Hope you have fun!
